annotations.title: Look up the national packaging register

description: Where to register packaging in one EU country, for example LUCID in Germany, the UIN (IDU) from SYDEREP in France, BDO in Poland, Verpact in the Netherlands or EDM in Austria (national packaging register, extended producer responsibility or EPR): the register name, operator, official URL and the registration number a seller shows, with notes and sources. Covers DE, FR, NL, IT, ES, RO, PL, AT, BE, CZ, SE and DK; entries not confirmed on an official page are marked unverified. Registers for batteries, electrical equipment or textiles are not covered.

country.description: EU country as a two-letter ISO code, e.g. "DE" (Germany), "FR" (France), "PL" (Poland), "NL" (Netherlands)

name: epr_packaging_register_lookup
title: Look up the national packaging register
